ResumePage.name: Sie Ren-Bin
ResumePage.about: AI Agent / LLM Application Engineer with a frontend foundation — agent tooling, RAG/MCP integrations, and the UIs that ship them.
ResumePage.summary: Software engineer building web apps since 2022, including banking and e-commerce client work, now focused on AI agents. Currently a vendor engineer at Google via Wipro, working on an internal browser-to-device web console. Builds multi-agent pipelines, agent-callable tools and guardrail hooks for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Antigravity, with cited retrieval and MCP integrations, and has wired OpenAI, Gemini and local open-source models (Ollama) behind one provider interface. Works directly with business stakeholders to turn requirements into shipped features.

work.title: Software Engineer · Developer Tools
work.description:
Device Developer Tooling:
• Develop Angular front-end features and back-end endpoints for an internal web console that connects to devices from the browser (Web Serial/WebUSB) to speed up device development; now in dogfood
• Standardized how the web console's front-end and back-end dev servers run and ran a code-health pass, using internal AI coding agents with project rules as agent memory, agent skills and plan-mode reviews

Usability:
• Drafted the web console's dogfood survey on usability for non-technical users (tooltips, docs, clarity on tracked activity) and filed usability bugs found in testing

work.title: Front End Developer

Code Quality:
• Abstracted data-flow libraries and established coding standards, improving code readability and maintenance efficiency by 35%

Infrastructure:
• Deployed the development environment inside the bank's air-gapped network, meeting strict security requirements

work.title: Front End Developer
work.description:

Critical Bug Resolution:

Development Velocity:
• Established a cross-device testing workflow (Ngrok, Android Studio) and custom NPM modules, accelerating development velocity by 45%

work.title: Front End Developer

projects.title: zkfy
projects.description: Multi-agent Claude Code plugin (also on Codex, Pi, Antigravity) turning URLs, videos and text into linked Obsidian notes: eight prompt-defined agents run a discover → distill → render → integrate pipeline, with cited vault retrieval, Notion MCP intake and web-clipper, a companion agent-callable clipper built on Obsidian Web Clipper. v1.8.1, 88 unit tests.

projects.title: ai-dotfiles
projects.description: One agent toolkit for four coding-agent CLIs from a single source: 17 original skills plus adapted community ones, shared MCP config, and guardrail hooks such as a PreToolUse hook that gives each agent task its own git worktree (1,388 lines, 107 tests); a nightly headless Claude Code run, limited to one allowlisted command, writes a personal dev log. 654 tests in CI.

projects.title: lan2cli
projects.description: Natural-language-to-shell CLI forked from Builder.io's ai-shell. Refactored its OpenAI-only code into one provider interface over OpenAI, Gemini and local open-source models via Ollama, with streams normalized to one SSE shape and about 64 tests.
